# Appendix A: Pre-release checklist

Every recommendation in the book, 192 in all, as one line you can tick.
Work through it before you release a design.
Each line links to the full recommendation, which gives the reasons and the numbers.
These are recommendations, not rules: where you choose not to follow one, it helps to tell your manufacturer why.

## Part 1: The design package (what you send)

### [Fabrication data](../01-design-package/01-fabrication-data.md)

- [ ] **PCB-DFM-008:** [Send one complete fabrication package, in one format, from one revision](../01-design-package/01-fabrication-data.md#pcb-dfm-008-send-one-complete-fabrication-package-in-one-format-from-one-revision)
- [ ] **PCB-DFM-009:** [Always send a netlist, made from the same revision as the Gerbers](../01-design-package/01-fabrication-data.md#pcb-dfm-009-always-send-a-netlist-made-from-the-same-revision-as-the-gerbers)
- [ ] **PCB-DFM-010:** [Tell the fab where you join nets on purpose](../01-design-package/01-fabrication-data.md#pcb-dfm-010-tell-the-fab-where-you-join-nets-on-purpose)
- [ ] **PCB-DFM-011:** [Separate plated and non-plated holes, and use an unambiguous drill format](../01-design-package/01-fabrication-data.md#pcb-dfm-011-separate-plated-and-non-plated-holes-and-use-an-unambiguous-drill-format)
- [ ] **PCB-DFM-012:** [Dimension the holes that matter, with their real tolerance](../01-design-package/01-fabrication-data.md#pcb-dfm-012-dimension-the-holes-that-matter-with-their-real-tolerance)
- [ ] **PCB-DFM-013:** [Put your intent in the data, not in a note that contradicts it](../01-design-package/01-fabrication-data.md#pcb-dfm-013-put-your-intent-in-the-data-not-in-a-note-that-contradicts-it)
- [ ] **PCB-DFM-014:** [Put everything the Gerbers can't say on the fabrication drawing](../01-design-package/01-fabrication-data.md#pcb-dfm-014-put-everything-the-gerbers-cant-say-on-the-fabrication-drawing)
- [ ] **PCB-DFM-015:** [Check a copied fabrication drawing line by line](../01-design-package/01-fabrication-data.md#pcb-dfm-015-check-a-copied-fabrication-drawing-line-by-line)
- [ ] **PCB-DFM-016:** [Clear every design-rule error before you make the outputs](../01-design-package/01-fabrication-data.md#pcb-dfm-016-clear-every-design-rule-error-before-you-make-the-outputs)
